reconciliation.difference_explanation: Phase 0 audited all 170 Python test modules in the repository (167 test_*.py files in tests/, plus tests/conftest.py, tests/utils.py, and chatbot/model_backend/test_backend.py). Phase 1 focused strictly on the 167 test_*.py suites under tests/.

controls_audited.behavior_tested: Verifies valid email/password returns Ed25519 access token and opaque refresh token; checks invalid passwords trigger 401 AuthenticationError
controls_audited.expected_security_property: Argon2id password verification, inactive accounts rejected, audit event logged
controls_audited.attack_case: Credential stuffing with invalid password; inactive account login attempt

controls_audited.behavior_tested: Verifies that token signed with primary Ed25519 key validates; rejects tokens signed with arbitrary algorithms or bad signatures; tests zero-downtime key rotation via JWT_PREVIOUS_PUBLIC_KEY
controls_audited.expected_security_property: Pinned EdDSA algorithm, issuer/aud validation, rejection of alg=none
controls_audited.attack_case: Algorithm confusion (HS256/none), signature tampering, expired JWT presentation

controls_audited.control_name: Refresh Token Rotation & Theft / Reuse Detection
controls_audited.behavior_tested: Simulates concurrent refresh requests and replays of an already-used refresh token; verifies entire token family is revoked upon replay
controls_audited.expected_security_property: Single-use atomic rotation, family-level revocation upon token reuse, SHA-256 hashed storage
controls_audited.attack_case: Attacker replays stolen refresh token after legitimate client rotated it

controls_audited.behavior_tested: Tests /auth/google/login state generation and /auth/google/callback verification with mock Google JWKS
controls_audited.expected_security_property: Ed25519-signed state JWT, single-use state jti, nonce match, verified email check
controls_audited.attack_case: CSRF state manipulation, forged ID token signature, unverified Google email login

controls_audited.behavior_tested: Executes calls to admin/operator endpoints with Client, Lawyer, generic Admin, and Admin holding specific OperationalPermission
controls_audited.expected_security_property: 403 Forbidden raised unless exact operational permission is held or SYSTEM_OPERATIONS super-privilege applies
controls_audited.attack_case: Client or unprivileged admin attempts to execute user suspension or incident transition

controls_audited.behavior_tested: User A creates a case; User B attempts to read, modify, or delete User A's case and documents
controls_audited.expected_security_property: Returns HTTP 404 ResourceNotFoundError to prevent ID existence enumeration
controls_audited.attack_case: Direct object reference manipulation using known UUIDs across tenant boundaries

controls_audited.behavior_tested: Requests password reset for existing and non-existing email; verifies 256-bit token entropy; redeems token and verifies all active sessions are revoked
controls_audited.expected_security_property: Generic 200 response on request; single-use token invalidation; immediate session termination
controls_audited.attack_case: User account enumeration via response timing/message; replay of used reset token

controls_audited.behavior_tested: Dispatches 6-digit OTP code, checks 15-minute expiration, verifies OTP, and confirms token cannot be reused
controls_audited.expected_security_property: Single-use SHA-256 hashed token record, 15-minute TTL, rate limit of 10/min
controls_audited.attack_case: Brute-force OTP code guessing; replay of verified OTP code

controls_audited.behavior_tested: Sends /auth/refresh request with cookie but without X-CSRF-Token or with cross-origin header; verifies request is rejected
controls_audited.expected_security_property: CSRF validation enforced on ambient cookies and in production; Origin header checked
controls_audited.attack_case: Cross-site request forgery attack from malicious third-party site invoking /auth/refresh

controls_audited.behavior_tested: Fires rapid requests exceeding route limits on /auth/login and /auth/register
controls_audited.expected_security_property: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests returned with RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED code
controls_audited.attack_case: High-frequency brute-force login attack or registration spamming

controls_audited.behavior_tested: Sends raw Stripe payload with valid and invalid Stripe-Signature; replays identical event ID multiple times
controls_audited.expected_security_property: Invalid HMAC signature rejected; duplicate event acknowledged with already_processed without re-executing credit
controls_audited.attack_case: Forged payment intent webhook; replay attack to double-credit consultation balance

controls_audited.behavior_tested: Calls /api/v1/auth/me, /api/v1/users, and /api/v1/admin/users/{id}; parses response JSON structure
controls_audited.expected_security_property: password_hash, token_hash, and secret keys are completely absent from serialized output
controls_audited.attack_case: Information leakage of password hash or session tokens via API responses

controls_audited.behavior_tested: Submits UserCreate with injected fields: is_admin, is_superuser, account_status
controls_audited.expected_security_property: Pydantic extra='forbid' triggers HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity
controls_audited.attack_case: Client injects is_admin=True or is_superuser=True in registration JSON payload

controls_audited.behavior_tested: Submits role='ADMIN' during registration; attempts to assign operator permissions from Client session
controls_audited.expected_security_property: Registration raises 403 Forbidden; operator permission routes require SYSTEM_OPERATIONS
controls_audited.attack_case: User requests ADMIN role at signup or modifies own role in DB via API

controls_audited.behavior_tested: Inspects response headers across API endpoints and OPTIONS preflight requests
controls_audited.expected_security_property: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, HSTS in prod, CORS origins restricted
controls_audited.attack_case: Clickjacking, MIME sniffing, wildcard CORS cross-origin credential theft
